purpose: Teach: 引き継ぐ/ジュエリー/賜物/見積り/雄大/摘出/要所/国税庁

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、先輩の研究、本気で、絶対、引き継ぐ、絶対、よう、絶対、頼むぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I need you to take over the senior researcher's work. I'm serious. You have to do this.
lines.style: Direct, weighing each phrase. Measured pace that undercuts urgency with calm certainty. Slight pause before 'you have to do this' — not a request, a responsibility being placed. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の、本気で、絶対、ジュエリー、絶対、と、絶対、いえる、絶対、貴重資料、絶対、大切に管理しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm managing the lab's precious materials and documents carefully. Thank you for the opportunity.
lines.style: Formal but genuine, not stiff. Respectful without being obsequious. Each phrase deliberate, showing he's thought this through. Slight nod rhythm. Voice steady but a touch uncertain at the edges — aware of the weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お前の研究、本気で、絶対、教授、絶対、賜物、絶対、と、絶対、評価されているぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your research has been recognized by the professor as a real gift. You're the right person for this.
lines.style: Warm, solid delivery. Genuine praise given plainly — no inflation. Slight lean forward. The words land like a statement of fact, not flattery. Conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の、本気で、絶対、見積り、絶対、まとめております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm compiling all the research fund estimates and documentation. Thank you for your confidence.
lines.style: Methodical, detail-oriented tone. Voice shows competence and focus. Each item accounted for. Not rushed. A touch of relief in acknowledging the trust placed in him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、雄大、絶対、な研究テーマ、絶対、頼もしいぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your research theme is ambitious and promising. I'm confident in you.
lines.style: Steady, encouraging. Deliberate emphasis on 'ambitious' — marking it as strength not liability. Measured pace. The kind of calm affirmation that settles in the chest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、課題、絶対、摘出、絶対、教授と、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm working through the paper's key issues with the professor. We're making progress.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Small-paced, careful. Shows he's genuinely engaged in the work, not just collecting tasks. Voice suggests both humility and capability — this is hard work and he's doing it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究の、本気で、絶対、要所、絶対、しっかり、絶対、押さえろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Keep your focus on the critical elements of the research. Don't lose sight of what matters most.
lines.style: Steady guidance, not demanding. Slight teacher-like cadence — he's pointing, not pushing. Calm authority. The words carry weight but without pressure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究助成金、本気で、絶対、国税庁、絶対、関連の、絶対、書類、絶対、揃えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've gathered all the research grant documents and government forms. Everything is in order. Thank you.
lines.style: Careful, thorough delivery. Shows preparedness without boasting. Professional tone with a note of underlying care — he takes this seriously. Slight exhale of completion at the end.
